The PKGBUILD is safe to process with `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` and `makepkg --printsrcinfo`.

The source URLs are well-known and point to the official project's release artifacts, making this a standard AUR package distribution approach.

During `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare`, the source archives will be downloaded and extracted, but no code execution occurs—only the files are read and installed. Since the build step is skipped, there is no opportunity for malicious payloads to run. The extraction writes files to disk but does not execute them, and the subsequent `--printsrcinfo` command will simply parse the PKGBUILD without modifying anything.

Therefore, this file poses no security risk for the specified commands.
</details>
